title: Source-level EEG dysconnectivity in drug-naïve patients with major depressive disorder: Bridging neural oscillations with potential neuroelectrophysiological markers.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based source localization offers a new perspective for investigating the neurophysiological origins of functional connectivity (FC) disruptions in major depressive disorder (MDD). This study aims to further elucidate the pathophysiological mechanisms in drug-naïve MDD patients and identify potential neuroelectrophysiological markers.
METHODS: This study enrolled a total of 247 participants, comprising 154 drug-naïve MDD patients and 93 healthy controls (HC) matched for sex and age. General demographic information was collected and scale assessments were conducted for all subjects. Resting-state EEG signals with eyes closed were recorded using a 64-channel EEG system. Brain activity was identified through source reconstruction, and FC in the δ, θ, α and β frequency bands was calculated using the weighted phase lag index (wPLI). Network-based statistics (NBS) were employed to compare FC differences between the two groups across frequency bands, and correlations with clinical scale scores were further examined.
RESULTS: Compared with the HC group, the MDD group showed significantly reduced FC in the θ band within several brain regions, including the left medial superior frontal gyrus, left precentral gyrus, right putamen, right postcentral gyrus, and left thalamus. Lower θ band network connectivity was associated with higher levels of anhedonia. Furthermore, within the MDD group, local θ band FC was positively correlated with rumination and the number of depressive episodes, negatively correlated with the age of onset, and not correlated with the severity of anxiety or depression.
CONCLUSION: This study contributes to the growing evidence base for large-scale network dysfunction in MDD. The identified abnormalities may inform future efforts to establish clinically usable potential neuroelectrophysiological markers.

标题：首发未用药重度抑郁障碍患者的源级脑电图功能连接异常：桥接神经振荡与潜在神经电生理标志物  
摘要：背景：基于脑电图（EEG）的源定位为研究重度抑郁障碍（MDD）中功能连接（FC）紊乱的神经生理起源提供了新视角。本研究旨在进一步阐明首发未用药MDD患者的病理生理机制，并识别潜在的神经电生理标志物。  
方法：本研究共纳入247名参与者，包括154名首发未用药MDD患者和93名性别与年龄匹配的健康对照组（HC）。收集所有受试者的一般人口学信息并进行量表评估。使用64通道脑电图系统记录静息态闭眼脑电信号。通过源重建识别大脑活动，并采用加权相位滞后指数（wPLI）计算δ、θ、α和β频段的FC。运用基于网络的统计分析（NBS）比较两组在不同频段的FC差异，并进一步检验其与临床量表评分的相关性。  
结果：与HC组相比，MDD组在θ频段内多个脑区（包括左侧内侧额上回、左侧中央前回、右侧壳核、右侧中央后回和左侧丘脑）的FC显著降低。较低的θ频段网络连接性与更高水平的快感缺失相关。此外，在MDD组内，局部θ频段FC与反刍思维和抑郁发作次数呈正相关，与发病年龄呈负相关，但与焦虑或抑郁的严重程度无相关性。  
结论：本研究为MDD中大规模网络功能异常的现有证据提供了进一步支持。识别出的异常可能为未来建立临床可用的潜在神经电生理标志物提供参考。  
关键词：重度抑郁障碍；功能连接；脑电图；θ频段；神经电生理标志物

title: State anxiety may mediate the association between striato-cortical circuitry and anxiety symptom severity in generalized anxiety disorder: A resting-state fMRI study and support vector machine analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Patients with generalized anxiety disorder (GAD) show structural and functional striatal abnormalities. While state and trait anxiety are known to modulate neural circuits influencing anxiety progression, the specific role of striatal-cortical circuitry in relation to anxiety dimensions in GAD remains unclear.
METHODS: We included 43 GAD patients and 36 healthy controls (HCs), assessing trait/state anxiety and collecting resting-state fMRI data. The striatal seed-based functional connectivity (FC) was compared between groups. Correlation analyses evaluated links between striatal FC, clinical symptoms, and anxiety measures. Mediation analysis tested whether state anxiety mediates FC-symptom relationships. A linear support vector machine (SVM) model assessed striatal FC's ability to classify GAD vs. HCs.
RESULTS: GAD patients exhibited increased FC between the right ventral superior striatum and medial prefrontal cortex, left dorsal caudal putamen (DCP) and left middle temporal gyrus, and right DCP and right MTG/fusiform gyrus, but decreased FC between the left ventral rostral putamen and left inferior parietal lobule/supramarginal gyrus. The FC between the right DCP and right MTG/fusiform exploratorily negatively correlated with HAMA and State Anxiety Inventory scores. State anxiety statistically mediate the relationship between striatal FC and anxiety severity. Linear and Gaussian SVM classifiers achieved accuracies of 81.07% and 79.82%, respectively.
CONCLUSIONS: GAD involves disrupted striato-cortical connectivity. State anxiety statistically mediate the relationship between striatal FC and clinical anxiety in an exploratory cross-sectional mediation framework, which may highlight its central role. Altered striatal-cortical FC may show potential candidate features for distinguish GAD patients from HC in exploratory proof-of-concept analyses.

标题：状态焦虑可能介导了广泛性焦虑障碍中纹状体-皮层环路与焦虑症状严重程度之间的关联：一项静息态功能磁共振成像研究与支持向量机分析
摘要：背景：广泛性焦虑障碍（GAD）患者表现出纹状体结构和功能的异常。尽管状态焦虑与特质焦虑已知能够调节影响焦虑进展的神经回路，但纹状体-皮层环路在GAD中与焦虑维度相关的具体作用仍不清楚。方法：我们纳入了43名GAD患者和36名健康对照（HCs），评估了特质/状态焦虑并收集了静息态功能磁共振成像数据。比较了两组间基于纹状体种子点的功能连接（FC）。相关性分析评估了纹状体功能连接、临床症状和焦虑测量指标之间的关联。中介分析检验了状态焦虑是否介导了功能连接与症状之间的关系。线性支持向量机（SVM）模型评估了纹状体功能连接在区分GAD与HCs方面的能力。结果：GAD患者表现出右腹侧纹状体上部与内侧前额叶皮层、左背侧尾状核壳部（DCP）与左颞中回、以及右DCP与右颞中回/梭状回之间的功能连接增强，但左腹侧壳核前部与左顶下小叶/缘上回之间的功能连接减弱。探索性分析发现，右DCP与右颞中回/梭状回之间的功能连接与汉密尔顿焦虑量表（HAMA）和状态焦虑量表评分呈负相关。状态焦虑在统计上介导了纹状体功能连接与焦虑严重程度之间的关系。线性和高斯SVM分类器分别达到了81.07%和79.82%的准确率。结论：GAD涉及纹状体-皮层连接的破坏。在探索性横截面中介分析框架中，状态焦虑在统计上介导了纹状体功能连接与临床焦虑之间的关系，这可能突显了其核心作用。在探索性概念验证分析中，异常的纹状体-皮层功能连接可能显示出区分GAD患者与HCs的潜在候选特征。
关键词：广泛性焦虑障碍；状态焦虑；纹状体-皮层环路；静息态功能磁共振成像；支持向量机

title: Association of Esketamine use with mortality and clinical outcomes in patients with cancer-related depression: A target trial emulation.
summary: Although esketamine shows efficacy for treatment-resistant depression, its potential effectiveness in cancer-related depression (CRD) has not been well-established. We therefore evaluated the real-world effectiveness and safety of esketamine in CRD using a target trial emulation framework based on anonymized electronic health records from the TriNetX network. Adults aged 18-74 years with CRD who initiated esketamine or oral antidepressant monotherapy between March 5, 2019, and December 31, 2024, were included. The primary outcome was all-cause mortality; secondary outcomes encompassed emergency room (ER) visits, intensive care unit (ICU) visits, hospitalizations, suicide-related events, palliative care, several physical complications, and psychiatric outcomes. Outcomes were assessed at two years after the index event and summarized across three follow-up windows, using Kaplan-Meier estimations and Cox proportional hazards models. After propensity score matching, 1751 patients per group were included. Compared with the oral-antidepressant-only group, esketamine initiation was associated with significantly lower risks of 2-year all-cause mortality (hazard ratio [HR] 0.737, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.614-0.886), ER visits (HR 0.574, 95% CI 0.501-0.657), ICU visits (HR 0.538, 95% CI 0.423-0.683), and psychotherapy utilization (HR 0.267, 95% CI 0.171-0.418). The esketamine group also showed a lower risk of ischemic stroke (HR 0.394, 95% CI 0.223-0.698), and subgroup analyses indicated that these observed associations were more pronounced in older patients. Overall, esketamine was associated with lower mortality and generally comparable safety outcomes in CRD, supporting its role as a potential therapeutic option for managing CRD.

标题：艾司氯胺酮使用与癌症相关抑郁症患者死亡率及临床结局的关联：一项目标试验模拟研究
摘要：尽管艾司氯胺酮对难治性抑郁症显示出疗效，但其在癌症相关抑郁症（CRD）中的潜在有效性尚未明确。因此，我们基于TriNetX网络的匿名电子健康记录，采用目标试验模拟框架评估了艾司氯胺酮在CRD中的真实世界有效性和安全性。研究对象为2019年3月5日至2024年12月31日期间开始使用艾司氯胺酮或口服抗抑郁药单药治疗的18-74岁CRD成年患者。主要结局为全因死亡率；次要结局包括急诊就诊、重症监护病房入住、住院、自杀相关事件、姑息治疗、多种躯体并发症及精神科结局。在指标事件后两年评估结局，并总结三个随访窗口的数据，采用Kaplan-Meier估计和Cox比例风险模型进行分析。经倾向评分匹配后，每组纳入1751例患者。与仅口服抗抑郁药组相比，使用艾司氯胺酮与2年全因死亡率（风险比0.737，95%置信区间0.614-0.886）、急诊就诊（风险比0.574，95%置信区间0.501-0.657）、重症监护病房入住（风险比0.538，95%置信区间0.423-0.683）及心理治疗使用（风险比0.267，95%置信区间0.171-0.418）风险显著降低相关。艾司氯胺酮组缺血性卒中风险也较低（风险比0.394，95%置信区间0.223-0.698），亚组分析显示这些关联在老年患者中更为显著。总体而言，艾司氯胺酮与CRD患者较低的死亡率及总体可比的安全性结局相关，支持其作为CRD潜在治疗选择的角色。
关键词：癌症相关抑郁症；艾司氯胺酮；死亡率；情绪障碍；真实世界研究

title: Anxiety, for better or for worse.
summary: Anxiety is one of the most prevalent psychiatric disorders. Although people may feel anxiety when they suffer from a pathological condition, it is also a disorder in itself. However, under normal conditions, anxiety facilitates adaptation. This review discusses the adaptive function of anxiety and delves into the brain system, structures and neurotransmitters, involved in its regulation. This review also addresses psychosocial factors that can alter this regulatory system, leading to maladaptive anxiety. Additionally, this review discusses new pharmacological options with potential to alleviate pathological anxiety, as well as psychotherapeutic advances for behavioral management of this disorder.

标题：焦虑，无论好坏
摘要：焦虑是最普遍的精神障碍之一。尽管人们在患有病理状态时可能会感到焦虑，但焦虑本身也是一种障碍。然而，在正常情况下，焦虑有助于适应。本综述讨论了焦虑的适应功能，并深入探讨了参与其调节的脑系统、结构和神经递质。本综述还涉及可能改变这一调节系统、导致适应不良性焦虑的社会心理因素。此外，本综述讨论了具有缓解病理性焦虑潜力的新药理学选择，以及针对该障碍行为管理的心理治疗进展。
关键词：焦虑；情绪调节；脑机制；社会心理因素；精神障碍

title: Decision-making impairments according to history of suicide attempt in depression: A computational model analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: It is well-established that individuals who have attempted suicide present decision-making impairments. However, the underlying constructs that constitute decision-making are still being explored.
AIMS: To compare decision-making impairments in patients with a current or past depressive episode based on lifetime suicidal history and current depression.
METHODS: 295 patients with current and past depression were recruited and divided into 4 groups according to history of suicide attempt (suicide attempters (SA) or psychiatric controls (PC)) and severity of depression (high or low). The outcome representation learning (ORL) and the Prospect Valence Learning (PVL) models were applied to the Iowa Gambling Task (IGT) to extract estimations of feedback sensitivity, learning and consistency in the decision-making process. We also explored how childhood trauma moderated the relationship between the parameters and suicide.
RESULTS: The optimal model for our sample was the ORL. Among the five ORL parameters, low depressed PC showed lower reward learning and greater forgetfulness than SA, but higher deck perseverance was observed only when compared to high depressed SA. Moreover, punishment learning was able to differentiate SA groups in terms of depression severity. Furthermore, patients with high childhood trauma, high forgetfulness and deck perseverance were more likely to be in the SA cohort.
CONCLUSION: Suicide attempt may be linked to heightened feedback sensitivity to environmental contingencies, greater decision-making randomness and higher rumination. Moreover, the role of both forgetfulness and deck perseverance in trauma survivors at risk for suicide needs to be further investigated to refine their cognitive profile.

标题：基于自杀未遂史的抑郁症决策功能损害：一项计算模型分析
摘要：背景：已有充分证据表明，自杀未遂者存在决策功能损害。然而，构成决策过程的内在机制仍有待探索。目的：基于终身自杀史和当前抑郁状态，比较当前或既往抑郁发作患者的决策功能损害。方法：共招募295例当前或既往抑郁发作患者，根据自杀未遂史（自杀未遂组[SA]或精神科对照组[PC]）和抑郁严重程度（高或低）分为四组。采用结果表征学习（ORL）模型和前景效价学习（PVL）模型对爱荷华赌博任务（IGT）数据进行分析，以提取决策过程中反馈敏感性、学习能力和一致性的估计值。此外，还探讨了童年创伤如何调节这些参数与自杀之间的关系。结果：本样本中最优模型为ORL模型。在ORL五个参数中，低抑郁PC组相较于SA组表现出更低的奖赏学习能力和更高的遗忘倾向，但与高抑郁SA组相比时仅在牌组坚持性上存在差异。此外，惩罚学习能力能够根据抑郁严重程度区分SA组别。童年创伤高、遗忘倾向高和牌组坚持性高的患者更可能属于SA队列。结论：自杀未遂可能与对环境偶发事件的反馈敏感性增强、决策随机性增加以及反刍思维加剧有关。此外，需要进一步研究自杀风险创伤幸存者中遗忘倾向和牌组坚持性的作用，以完善其认知特征。
关键词：决策功能损害；抑郁症；自杀未遂；计算模型；反馈敏感性

title: Multi-level pathways linking personality and mood to problematic smartphone use: A behavioral and neuroimaging study.
summary: Problematic smartphone use (PSU) is shaped by personality traits and emotional states, yet its neural and molecular underpinnings remain unclear. Guided by the I-PACE model, we combined behavioral assessment, task-based fMRI, and whole-brain transcriptomics to investigate how dispositional greed (DGS) and depressive symptoms (BDI) contribute to PSU. Participants from middle school and university cohorts completed PSU, DGS, and BDI measures and performed a Face-Matching task during fMRI. Behaviorally, higher DGS was directly associated with greater PSU, with BDI partially mediating this link. Neuroimaging revealed altered activation patterns in visual, emotional, and cognitive control networks related to PSU. Mediation analyses identified pathways in which BDI → lingual/occipital pole → PSU and DGS → BDI → occipital regions → PSU explained the behavioral associations, highlighting visual processing circuits as key intermediaries. Integration of PSU-related brain activation maps with transcriptomic data identified 447 significantly correlated genes (188 positive, 259 negative). Gene Ontology enrichment showed nuclear transcriptional regulation for the positive set, linked via GAMBA to the visual network and high cerebral metabolic rate of oxygen. The negative set was enriched in mitochondrial and metabolic functions, mapped to limbic networks with low CMRO2 and structural vulnerability patterns in major psychiatric disorders. Overall, DGS and BDI increase PSU vulnerability through emotion-reactivity and cognitive-control deficits mediated by visual network activity, underpinned by distinct gene expression profiles. This multi-level framework offers mechanistic insights into PSU and supports precision-targeted interventions.

标题：人格与情绪影响问题性手机使用的多通路机制：一项行为与神经影像学研究
摘要：问题性手机使用受人格特质和情绪状态影响，但其神经与分子机制尚不明确。基于I-PACE模型，本研究结合行为评估、任务态功能磁共振成像及全脑转录组学，探讨了特质贪婪与抑郁症状对问题性手机使用的影响。来自初中和大学队列的参与者完成了问题性手机使用、特质贪婪和抑郁症状的测量，并在功能磁共振成像期间执行面孔匹配任务。行为学结果显示，高特质贪婪与问题性手机使用直接相关，且抑郁症状部分中介了这一关联。神经影像学揭示了与问题性手机使用相关的视觉、情绪和认知控制网络激活模式的改变。中介分析识别出多条通路：抑郁症状→舌回/枕极→问题性手机使用，以及特质贪婪→抑郁症状→枕区→问题性手机使用，表明视觉处理环路是关键中介。将问题性手机使用相关的脑激活图与转录组数据整合，发现447个显著相关基因（188个正向、259个负向）。基因本体富集显示，正向基因集富集于核转录调控，通过GAMBA通路与视觉网络及高脑氧代谢率相关；负向基因集富集于线粒体和代谢功能，映射至边缘网络，并与低脑氧代谢率及主要精神疾病的结构脆弱模式相关。总体而言，特质贪婪和抑郁症状通过视觉网络活动介导的情绪反应与认知控制缺陷，增加问题性手机使用易感性，并由独特的基因表达谱支撑。这一多层次框架为问题性手机使用提供了机制性见解，并支持精准干预策略。
关键词：问题性手机使用；特质贪婪；抑郁症状；功能磁共振成像；转录组学

title: Left-to-right dorsomedial prefrontal cortex interhemispheric projections mediate psychosocial stress vulnerability.
summary: Functional asymmetries in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) are significant attributes of this brain area, implicated in its role in emotional processing and executive function. Evidence suggests that, under normal conditions, there is a tonic inhibition of the right (R) mPFC by the left (L) mPFC, and a dysregulation of this hemispheric functional lateralization is implicated in detrimental chronic stress effects. Considering the wide interhemispheric connection and the inhibitory tone from the LmPFC to the RmPFC, we hypothesize that alterations in the activity of the direct projections between the mPFC hemispheres during stressful situations are related to stress vulnerability. To address this question, we used a chemogenetic approach to modulate the activity of L-to-R dorsomedial prefrontal cortex (dmPFC) monosynaptic projections during psychosocial stress (PSS) exposure in mice. We found that activating LdmPFC projections during a repeated PSS protocol prevents stress-induced apathy-like behavior in females and males and social avoidance in male mice. On the other hand, inhibiting such projections during a single session of PSS increases vulnerability to stress effects in male mice, increasing social avoidance and anxiety-like behaviors. Both glutamatergic and GABAergic cells compose the projecting interhemispheric neurons in the dmPFC. However, the LdmPFC showed a higher density of glutamatergic projections to the RdmPFC than the opposite. In conclusion, our results revealed an involvement of the monosynaptic projections from the LdmPFC to RdmPFC in the vulnerability to the behavioral alterations induced by PSS in female and male mice.

标题：左至右背内侧前额叶皮层半球间投射介导心理社会应激脆弱性
摘要：内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）的功能不对称是该脑区的重要特征，与其在情绪加工和执行功能中的作用有关。证据表明，在正常条件下，左侧（L）mPFC对右侧（R）mPFC存在紧张性抑制，而这一半球功能侧化的失调与有害的慢性应激效应相关。考虑到广泛的半球间连接以及LmPFC对RmPFC的抑制性紧张，我们假设在应激情境下，mPFC半球间直接投射活动的改变与应激脆弱性有关。为探讨此问题，我们采用化学遗传学方法，在小鼠暴露于心理社会应激（PSS）期间调节左至右背内侧前额叶皮层（dmPFC）单突触投射的活动。结果发现，在重复PSS方案中激活LdmPFC投射可预防雌性和雄性小鼠的应激诱导的冷漠样行为以及雄性小鼠的社交回避；相反，在单次PSS期间抑制此类投射则会增加雄性小鼠对应激效应的脆弱性，表现为社交回避和焦虑样行为增加。dmPFC中的投射性半球间神经元由谷氨酸能和GABA能细胞组成，但LdmPFC向RdmPFC的谷氨酸能投射密度高于相反方向。总之，我们的结果揭示了从LdmPFC到RdmPFC的单突触投射参与调节雌性和雄性小鼠由PSS诱导的行为改变的脆弱性。
关键词：情绪加工；心理社会应激；前额叶皮层功能侧化；应激脆弱性；社交回避

title: The RBFOX1 regulatory gene network contributes to major depressive disorder, anxiety, irritability and neuroticism.
summary: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is a complex psychiatric disorder frequently comorbid with anxiety disorders, suicide attempts, and personality traits such as irritability and neuroticism. RBFOX1, which encodes a splicing factor, is a known risk gene for MDD, and has also been associated with anxiety and neuroticism. However, the working mechanisms of how RBFOX1 influences these conditions are not yet understood. Here, we aim to shed light on the effects of RBFOX1 and its regulated genes on MDD, and the traits anxiety, irritability, neuroticism, as well as suicide attempt using genome-wide association study (GWAS) data from previous research. We demonstrate that RBFOX1 is associated with MDD, anxiety, and neuroticism, and that genes associated with all tested phenotypes, except suicide attempts, are significantly enriched in RBFOX1-regulated genes. These genes show a substantial overlap between MDD and comorbid traits and are involved in neuronal development, synaptic processes, and neurotransmitter regulation. Our network analysis reveals that RBFOX1 functions as a central hub, integrating and coordinating neighbouring nodes. Through differential gene expression prediction and the study of rare disorders presenting with depression, anxiety, irritability, or neuroticism, alongside our previous analyses, we highlight 19 top-ranked genes regulated by RBFOX1, including CADM2, CTSB, MAPT, NSF, PAX6, SCAI, SNCA, SP4, and TCF4. Our findings underscore the key role of RBFOX1 and its regulated gene network in the genetic architecture of MDD and comorbid traits. These insights may contribute to improving the prevention and treatment of MDD in the future.

标题：RBFOX1调控基因网络在重性抑郁障碍、焦虑、易激惹及神经质中的作用
摘要：重性抑郁障碍（MDD）是一种复杂的精神疾病，常与焦虑障碍、自杀企图以及易激惹和神经质等人格特质共病。编码剪接因子的RBFOX1是MDD的已知风险基因，也与焦虑和神经质相关。然而，RBFOX1如何影响这些疾病的工作机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在利用既往研究的全基因组关联分析（GWAS）数据，阐明RBFOX1及其调控基因对MDD、焦虑、易激惹、神经质及自杀企图的影响。我们发现RBFOX1与MDD、焦虑和神经质相关，且除自杀企图外，所有检测表型相关基因在RBFOX1调控基因中显著富集。这些基因在MDD与其共病特质之间表现出显著重叠，并涉及神经元发育、突触过程和神经递质调节。我们的网络分析揭示RBFOX1作为中枢枢纽，整合并协调邻近节点。通过差异基因表达预测以及对伴有抑郁、焦虑、易激惹或神经质的罕见疾病研究，结合既往分析，我们突出了RBFOX1调控的19个排名最高的基因，包括CADM2、CTSB、MAPT、NSF、PAX6、SCAI、SNCA、SP4和TCF4。我们的发现强调了RBFOX1及其调控基因网络在MDD及其共病特质遗传结构中的关键作用。这些见解可能有助于未来改善MDD的预防和治疗。

title: Chronobiological disruption in ADHD: Developmental mechanisms linking sleep, behavior, and comorbid conditions.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is increasingly recognized as a neurodevelopmental condition involving both dopaminergic dysfunction and circadian misalignment. While these mechanisms have traditionally been studied independently, their combined impact on symptom expression and comorbidity-particularly with mood disorders, substance use disorders, and obesity-remains insufficiently understood. This review aims to integrate current evidence on the interaction between circadian and dopaminergic dysfunction in ADHD and to evaluate the therapeutic potential of chronobiological interventions.
METHODS: We conducted an integrative review of studies across neurobiology, chronobiology, psychopharmacology, and genetics, including evidence from both human and animal models. The review focuses on molecular and clinical findings related to circadian regulation, dopaminergic signaling, and their interaction in ADHD pathophysiology and treatment response.
RESULTS: Evidence indicates that dopaminergic dysregulation contributes to impaired reward processing and motivational deficits, while circadian disruption is associated with sleep disturbances, emotional dysregulation, and metabolic dysfunction. These processes appear to interact bidirectionally, potentially amplifying symptom severity and comorbidity. Emerging findings implicate circadian genes-particularly CRY1-in the regulation of both neural and metabolic pathways. Chronotherapeutic interventions, including light therapy, melatonin supplementation, and sleep-focused behavioral strategies, show promise, particularly when aligned with individual circadian profiles.
CONCLUSIONS: Elucidating the interplay between circadian misalignment and dopaminergic dysfunction may inform more precise, biomarker-guided treatment strategies in ADHD. Stratified care models that incorporate circadian timing and individual variability have the potential to improve outcomes and address the high comorbidity burden. Large-scale, controlled clinical studies are needed to validate these approaches and facilitate their translation into personalized interventions.

相关性：是
标题：ADHD中的生物节律紊乱：连接睡眠、行为与共病的发展机制
摘要：背景：注意缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）日益被认为是一种涉及多巴胺能功能障碍和昼夜节律失调的神经发育性疾病。尽管这些机制传统上被独立研究，但它们对症状表现和共病（尤其是情绪障碍、物质使用障碍和肥胖）的综合影响仍未被充分理解。本综述旨在整合ADHD中昼夜节律与多巴胺能功能障碍相互作用的最新证据，并评估生物节律干预的治疗潜力。
方法：我们对神经生物学、时间生物学、精神药理学和遗传学领域的研究进行了整合性综述，包括来自人类和动物模型的证据。综述聚焦于与昼夜节律调节、多巴胺能信号传导及其在ADHD病理生理和治疗反应中相互作用的分子和临床发现。
结果：证据表明，多巴胺能失调导致奖赏处理受损和动机缺陷，而昼夜节律紊乱与睡眠障碍、情绪失调和代谢功能障碍相关。这些过程可能双向相互作用，从而加剧症状严重性和共病风险。新兴研究发现昼夜节律基因（特别是CRY1）在神经和代谢通路调节中发挥作用。时间治疗干预措施（包括光疗、褪黑素补充和以睡眠为中心的行为策略）显示出前景，尤其是当与个体昼夜节律特征相匹配时。
结论：阐明昼夜节律失调与多巴胺能功能障碍之间的相互作用，可为ADHD提供更精准的生物标志物指导治疗策略。结合昼夜节律时间和个体差异的分层护理模型有望改善预后并应对高共病负担。需要大规模对照临床研究来验证这些方法，并促进其转化为个性化干预方案。
关键词：ADHD；昼夜节律失调；多巴胺能功能障碍；情绪失调；生物节律干预
